_about: Independent re-derivation paths used by qc_agent.py. For each tool the agent used, QC calls a DIFFERENTLY SHAPED governed tool and recomputes the figures. 'compare' maps an aggregate-side column to an aggregate over detail-side rows (count | sum:<column>). drilldown: the agent used the aggregate tool; QC fetches the detail rows per aggregate row (arguments_from_row) and recomputes each aggregate cell. rollup: the agent used the detail tool; QC fetches the aggregate tool and checks the detail rows add up to it.
